name: MCT Oil
directions: Modular MCT source. The guide states 7.7 Cal/mL; its Nutrition Facts panel prints 80 Cal per 10 mL, which rounds to one significant figure.

name: HiFibre
directions: Measure 2 tablespoons (30 mL) per serving. Suitable for tube feeding; the Canadian sheet defers to the physician or dietitian for tube feeding instructions.

name: ProSource NoCarb Liquid Protein
directions: Tube feeding: dilute with 30 mL of water, infuse via syringe down the feeding tube, flush with 15-30 mL of water before and after administration.

name: BeneProtein
directions: Each 7 g serving provides 6 g of protein. It can be added to most foods, liquids and as a "protein flush" with tube feedings.

name: Boost Just Protein
directions: Each 21 g serving provides 18 g of protein. It can be added to most foods, liquids and as a "protein flush" with tube feedings.

name: Boost Powder
directions: For 280 ml serving prepared with 250 ml whole milk. For oral use.

name: BanatrAll with GOS
directions: Mix 1 package into your favourite non-carbonated beverage or moist foods. Once completely mixed, serve immediately or refrigerate up to 48 hours. Consult a physician or dietitian for tube feeding instructions.
